title: Runtime mutation of SceneMaterial line + hatch patterns
description: Two materials drive a six-box scene — one triangle-surface material that demonstrates runtime `hatchPattern` mutation, one line-primitive material that demonstrates runtime `linePattern` mutation. Clicking a button reassigns the material's pattern; the renderer subscribes to `onSceneMaterialPatternChanged` and re-encodes the affected slot in the per-batch HatchPatternTexture / LinePatternTexture without rebuilding the model. Per-mesh attribute storage is left untouched — the slot index is keyed on `material.uniqueId`, which doesn't change.
